data.content_ref: inline:The problem 0563ea623c17 integrates with SRC_001 by proposing that the 'fragmentation error' inherent in checklist-driven panels is the causal mechanism for their failure in non-linear tasks; this relation is refuted if it is shown that a checklist can be structured as a non-linear graph (conditional branching) that captures the same gestalt patterns as expert intuition.
